summary: This 8-K reports the remarketing of $15.0 million aggregate principal amount of New York State Environmental Facilities Corporation Solid Waste Disposal Revenue Bonds (Series 2014R-2) by Casella Waste Systems, Inc. on June 1, 2026. The bonds were remarketed at a 4.300% interest rate for a period ending June 1, 2036, with a final maturity of December 1, 2044. Proceeds were loaned to Casella to finance asset purchases in New York. The bonds are guaranteed by substantially all subsidiaries. This is a routine debt refinancing/remarketing event, not a special situation, so no deal terms or strategic angle apply.
